cues.en: Let's pause for another hands-on exercise.
cues.zh: 先停一下，做另一個實作練習。

cues.en: Revisit our EvaluateUserCF script again, and this time modify the recommender such that users that have a rating count more than 3 standard deviations from the mean are excluded from consideration.
cues.zh: 再次回到 EvaluateUserCF 程式，這次修改推薦器，讓評分數量與平均值相差超過三個標準差的使用者，不納入考量。

cues.en: This will eliminate so-called super-users who have an outsized impact on your results.
cues.zh: 這會排除對結果影響過大的所謂超級使用者。

cues.en: Let's measure the effect of filtering them out.
cues.zh: 來衡量濾除他們的效果。

cues.en: To do this, you'll probably want to focus your attention on the MovieLens module again.
cues.zh: 為此，大概又要把注意力放在 MovieLens 模組。

cues.en: The best place to filter out these outliers is in the function that actually loads the MovieLens data set itself.
cues.zh: 濾除這些離群值的最佳位置，就是實際載入 MovieLens 資料集本身的函式。

cues.en: Doing this easily will require some familiarity with the Pandas module, so if you're new to Pandas, you might want to just skip to my solution and learn from it.
cues.zh: 要輕鬆完成，需要熟悉 Pandas 模組。如果你是 Pandas 新手，也許可以直接跳到我的解答，從中學習。

cues.en: But if you are starting to feel comfortable with Pandas, give it a shot yourself, and compare your results to mine, up next.
cues.zh: 但如果已開始熟悉 Pandas，請自己試試，再與接下來我的結果比較。
